title: Mount Kailash as an energy vortex where fingernails grow faster

tellings.quote: Mount Kyash is an example. I think Sod Guru went and said that his fingernails grew faster on the mountain

plain: Mount Kailash, a mountain in Tibet, is said to be an energy vortex, a place where some unusual force gathers, so strong that fingernails grow faster there. Michels brings it up himself, repeating that the spiritual teacher Sadhguru said his own fingernails grew faster on the mountain. If true, it would mean some places on Earth really do change the body.
